Prashant Kishor's Jan Suraaj Party Eyes Delhi Entry

Prashant Kishor's Jan Suraaj Party (JSP) is preparing to contest upcoming polls in Delhi. JSP supporters are scheduled to hold a meeting in the national capital on Sunday, where a steering committee will be announced to establish the party's organizational structure and team in Delhi. The party is also felicitating Kishor.
